instruction: Create a local apt repository from downloaded packages
Add local repository to sources list
Download the complete list of available packages
Export list of all installed packages to file
Restore packages from exported list
Clone all packages from one system to another
output: dpkg --get-selections > packages.list && rsync -av packages.list user@host:~/ && ssh user@host "dpkg --set-selections < packages.list && apt dselect-upgrade -y"

instruction: List packages with priority required
List packages marked as auto-installed
Mark a package as manually installed
Mark all dependencies of nginx as auto
output: apt-mark auto $(apt-cache depends nginx | grep Depends | awk '{print $2}')

instruction: Check if a package can be removed safely
Find packages that depend on a specific library
Check package download size before installing
Show detailed apt statistics about the cache
Show unmet dependencies
Find packages with unsatisfied dependencies
List all orphaned packages (no dependencies)
Remove orphaned packages automatically
List packages installed by a specific task
output: apt-cache show task-desktop | grep Depends | tr ',' '\n'

instruction: Show all installed metapackages
output: apt-cache show $(dpkg -l | awk '/^ii/ {print $2}') 2>/dev/null | grep -B1 'Section: meta' | grep Package

instruction: Find available kernels you can boot into
Remove old kernels not in use
List all versions of an available package
Install the previous version of a package
Compare two package versions
output: dpkg --compare-versions 2.0 gt 1.0 && echo yes || echo no
